generated.description: A modern-style multi-level building made mostly of stone, smooth stone, dirt and gray wool, with jungle plank floors, red wool accents, spruce leaves and a few glass panes. It measures 34 wide, 13 high and 31 deep, and the top-down view shows a stepped layout with a central block and some small tower-like sections. Inside are a furnace, a sign and a skull as block entities, and there is a small water feature with sugar cane, sand and snow.
